```plato

    // The straight-line length of an undirected edge.
    EdgeLength(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Number
    {
        var pair = topology.UndirectedEdges[edge.Value];
        return self.Positions[pair.A.Value].Distance(self.Positions[pair.B.Value]);
    }
```
